name: Zola Mabena
bio:
Zola's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family of racers, but through a fascination with the artistry of custom car builds in her hometown. Seeing the intricate paint jobs transform vehicles ignited a passion for color and precision. After completing a vocational course in automotive refinishing, she quickly excelled, landing an apprenticeship at a local body shop specializing in high-end modifications. 

Her meticulous approach to color matching and surface preparation caught the eye of a Racing Start Academy scout. Zola's demanding nature pushes her to achieve perfection in every project. She believes that a flawless paint job is not just cosmetic; it's a reflection of the team's dedication to excellence and attention to detail. Her ability to envision the final product and relentlessly pursue that vision makes her an invaluable asset.

Zola is an innovator that is always looking for ways to improve the painting process and introduce new techniques that help the team stand out.

physical.hairStyle: Short, natural afro with carefully shaped edges.
physical.description: Zola is petite with a focused gaze and a determined set to her jaw.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not actively painting.
Has a collection of miniature paint sample models, organized by hue and finish.
Insists on using only vegan-friendly paint products.
